doc: Message layouts, filled in from recordings made with `record`. Until this has entries the tracker decodes nothing. Offsets count from the first byte after the length and opcode header. Types: u8, bool, u16, i16, u32, i32, u64, i64. Example entry: {"kind":"ItemAcquired","opcode":"0x1234","direction":"ServerToClient","fields":{"itemId":{"offset":0,"type":"u32"},"count":{"offset":4,"type":"u32"},"bound":{"offset":8,"type":"u8"}},"note":"seen after every loot pickup"}
